items.title: Hal ki jaanch aur behtari (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of evaluating and improving solutions (PDF 26).

blocks.text: Hal milne ke baad us ki jaanch (evaluation) zaroori hai. Jaanch dekhti hai ke hal durust hai ya nahi aur ghaltiyan dhoondne aur theek karne deti hai. Hal ko test karna dikhata hai ke woh theek kaam karta hai ya nahi.

items: Test karein: kya amal mein theek chalta hai?
Theek karein: ghaltiyan dhoond kar durust karein.
Behtar karein: hal ko saada ya tez banayein.

blocks.text: Yeh amal ghaltiyon se seekhne mein madad deta hai, aur hal ko behtar karna behtar karkardagi deta hai. Jaanch masla hal karne ka ahem hissa hai.

blocks.prompt: Figure 2.2 ka chai wala algorithm test kiya gaya aur chai pesh karte waqt thandi thi. Aap pehle kaun sa qadam jaanchenge, aur algorithm kaise behtar ho sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Ubaalne aur pesh karne ke darmiyan ke qadam jaanchein: ho sakta hai chai zyada der dam hone mein pani thanda ho gaya ho, ya doodh thanda ho. Behtari: dam ka waqt likhein (maslan chand minute) aur doodh garam karein, taake qadam har dafa wahi nateeja dein.

items: Hal ki jaanch: check, test, theek, behtar.
Jaanch ghaltiyon se seekhati aur behtar karkardagi deti.
